append.detail: Premise re-tested (ADR-1082): a Space already hides and reorders its own Apps in its Module Manager (/spaces/<slug>/manage/modules saves spaces.preferences.moduleMenu, ADR-546b), and appsForScope applies it on the space branch (applySpaceModuleMenu), pinned by lib/apps/for-scope.test.ts. Building a second per-Space store in app_overrides.space_id would be a parallel system, so the stale Phase 2 TODO in lib/apps/overrides.ts now points at the Module Manager and the reserved column stays unused. No migration.
